title: Apple Music Start class sounds within 1 s on iPhone Safari
acceptance: On iPhone Safari Live, the first Apple Music song is audible within 1 s of tapping Start class on 5G.
Work that needs no gesture (load MusicKit, configure, check authorization) happens before Start; only setQueue/play run in the tap.
nextAction: Instrumentation landed in #668 (97f4454). The owner's first timing run on 2026-10-31 (RF-108 evidence, HISTORY) measured audio 0.5-1.2 s after play() on Wi-Fi and fed RF-108's redesign (#669, live at 0a77110); criterion 0 (audible within 1 s of tapping Start on 5G) still needs the owner's timed Start on 5G. If set-queue dominates, the open question in #668 (cue the first song before Start) is next. #668 review items 3-6 (timing-log edge cases) are noted in this record's evidence for the next change to start-timing.ts.

evidence.summary: Owner iPhone Safari, 5G, Worker b41b99f9 (RF-122 live), screen recording 23:06: Start class played Break Stuff after about 5 s. Pause worked. Resume stuck on 'Waiting for music — Provider playback has not confirmed progress'. Next to Rollin' (Air Raid Vehicle) showed 'Playback stopped' with Playback error at class clock 2:47.
RF-124 closed 2026-10-29; the owner's passing iPhone runs did not time Start, so the 5 s figure from 2026-10-28 is still the only measurement.
Owner set Ready in session on 2026-10-30 ("Yes, option 1, Apple hardening"): RF-108, RF-128 and RF-147 as one Apple hardening lane.

Debug-only timing module apps/web/src/lib/playback/start-timing.ts (off unless ?playback-timing=1 or localStorage ritmo-playback-timing=1; logs step names only) wired through the Apple adapter. No pre-gesture work moved: LiveMode.tsx already gates Start on the "Check Apple Music authorization" step, which runs prepareAppleMusic (load + configure) and requires isAuthorized, so the tap path reuses the configured singleton.

Timing is off by default and logs nothing; turns on from the URL flag and localStorage; blocked storage keeps it off. Existing adapter test "reuses the page singleton without re-configuring or re-fetching the token" covers the tap path skipping configure.

Owner decision in session 2026-10-30, relayed by the coordinator after the fourth final review of #668 on 85442ac: option 1, measure first. #668 shrinks to the RF-128 timing instrumentation and the RF-147 cleanups that need no locks; everything else in apps/ reverts to main. The lock work (leases, settle wait, hard caps, attempt token) is preserved on wip/rf-108-apple-locks at 85442ac. After deploy the owner times Start and quick taps on the iPhone, and RF-108's locks are redesigned in a new PR around those numbers.

Final review of #668 on b70f529, items 3-6 (debug timing-log edge cases, not triggered by the owner's device steps; fix with the next change to start-timing.ts): (3) timedCall: a synchronous throw from play()/setQueue() leaves timingInFlight above zero, so later destroys log "cancelled"; (4) prepare() bumps timingAttempt on a live re-prepare, so a late settle from the previous prepare is labelled "(cancelled adapter)"; (5) readOptIn: a failing sessionStorage.setItem hides an existing localStorage opt-in; (6) a FairPlayStorage without getItem logs "not-1" whatever the flag is. Items 1-2 are RF-160.
